name: taskflow
description: TaskFlow: React frontend and Express API, deployable as one service
//build: Hosts set NODE_ENV=production, which makes npm skip devDependencies. The client needs its dev tools (vite, tailwind) to build at all, so ask for them explicitly; the server genuinely does not need its own.

scripts.build: npm install --omit=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
